title: Postman on the Fold
summary: An interactive folding Three.js paper atlas of a valley where you crease pleats to connect red-striped roads for a cycling postman.
description: An interactive folding paper atlas of Fold Valley with three letters to deliver. A red-striped road ends at either side of a pleat; folding the crease brings the road ends into contact so the postman can cycle across the seam past circling swallows, turning windmill sails, and a folded river skiff. Includes Bridge Fold, Hilltop Shortcut, Windmill Loop, manual fold dragging, Auto Story mode, and synthesized Web Audio sound.
